brief:
Gadi Eisenkot, leader of the Yisrael Atid party, received a mandate to form the Israeli government, Shehab Wire reported. His appointment marks a new phase in Israeli coalition politics but does not resolve his conflict with Benjamin Netanyahu.

The struggle between Eisenkot and Netanyahu is expected to shape negotiations ahead. Netanyahu remains a consequential force in Israeli politics despite stepping down from the premiership.

title: Eisenkot tasked with forming Israeli government amid ongoing Netanyahu feud
